method: One warmup, randomized paired allocator order, warm filesystem cache. GQ post_parse_compute_ms excludes parsing/startup/publication. Native commands use complete process wall time. Peak RSS is whole child process. Exact GQ semantic/work results, native data tables, replay files and ingest bytes are checked. Each pair supplies one speed ratio; percentile bootstrap CI uses resampling of paired median ratios, not independent samples. Serial GQ decoding is the release default; allocator tuning is explicitly recorded in mimalloc_tuning; no C malloc interposition.

experiments.query: header {gq=1,assembly="GRCh38"} let R=g[chr1:70122500..70142500] from @x.records |> within all |> derive {q=any unique{overlaps(R)},m=any multimap{any alternative{overlaps(R)}}} |> summarize {n=count(),q=count_true(q),m=count_true(m),reads=sum(reads.total)} by {sample}

predicate_effects.overlaps_and_end_in: extent-sensitive; conservative when omitted geometry is unresolved

semantics.sum_reads_after_where: sum selected units' total accepted observations, not reads satisfying the filter
semantics.support_reads: accepted-observation bounds; unique weights plus each multimapping signature once
semantics.universe: positive retained witness across unique representatives and grouped multimapper alternatives; children are not cropped
semantics.unknown: Kleene logic; omitted ends are not bounded by retained ends
